name: table-01
title: Table 01
description: A polished customers table with search, filtering, sorting, and pagination. Includes page selection.

meta.prompt:
Create a customer directory titled Customers with 12 sample customers, the eyebrow YOUR PEOPLE, and the subtitle “A little closer to every customer.” Use violet accents and initials avatars. Display Customer (name and email), Company, Plan, Total spent in whole USD, and Joined date. Color Starter badges violet, Pro emerald, and Enterprise amber.

Search names or emails and filter by Starter, Pro, or Enterprise. Support multiple selection with row checkboxes and a current-page select-all checkbox with an indeterminate state.

Use a full-width card up to 1024px with a rounded 16px border, subtle shadow, theme-aware surfaces, muted table header, generous row padding, and a compact icon tile beside the heading. Wrap toolbar and footer controls on narrow screens and retain a horizontally scrollable table at least 680px wide. Include labeled search and filter controls, keyboard-accessible sortable headings with direction indicators, five rows per page, result counts, page numbers, and Previous page / Next page buttons disabled at the boundaries. Search, filter, and sorting changes return to page one. Show a contextual empty state with Reset filters, and show Clear filters when filters are active.
